name: perf_journey_first8_picture
what: THE JOURNEY'S FIRST 8 MINUTES WITH THE PICTURE PASS (PERF-LEAD, 23 Nov; row 15 'no blue screen, ever'): journey_first8 with the page's background set to MAGENTA after the roll-out - flown with flight_script.js --screencast, a magenta frame in the recording is the page shown instead of the world (tools/perf/screen_read.py reads it) - and the draw guard's count at the end

steps.name: the page's background magenta
steps.js: (() => { document.documentElement.style.background = '#ff00ff'; document.body.style.background = '#ff00ff'; const G = window.FLYDIY_GUARD; return 'page background magenta; guard ' + (G ? JSON.stringify(G.stats && { held: G.stats.held, compiles: G.stats.compiles, ready: G.stats.ready, timedOut: G.stats.timedOut }) : 'absent'); })()

steps.name: the guard's count
steps.js: (() => { const G = window.FLYDIY_GUARD, A = window.FLYDIY_AA; return 'guard ' + (G ? JSON.stringify({ held: G.stats.held, compiles: G.stats.compiles, ready: G.stats.ready, timedOut: G.stats.timedOut, heldNow: G.heldNow, what: (G.stats.what || []).slice(0, 14) }) : 'absent') + ' | frames the AA stage held: ' + (A && A.held ? A.held() : 'n/a'); })()
